title: Basic English — Course 1, Semester 2 — Pilot Variant 14

tasks.prompt: Listening 1. Where will the placement briefing take place?
tasks.audioText: Students starting their work placement next month must attend a briefing on Monday at two o'clock. The meeting will be in Room 18, not in the usual assembly hall. Bring your placement documents and a pen. The tutor will explain attendance rules, workplace communication and who to contact if you are ill or cannot arrive on time. Please read the information sheet before the meeting.

tasks.prompt: Listening 2. What should students read before the meeting?
tasks.audioText: Students starting their work placement next month must attend a briefing on Monday at two o'clock. The meeting will be in Room 18, not in the usual assembly hall. Bring your placement documents and a pen. The tutor will explain attendance rules, workplace communication and who to contact if you are ill or cannot arrive on time. Please read the information sheet before the meeting.

tasks.prompt: Before her first work placement, Alina checked the company address and planned her journey. She saved the supervisor's telephone number and prepared a folder with her college documents. On the first day, she arrived fifteen minutes early, introduced herself to the team and asked where visitors should leave their coats. Reading 1. What did Alina do before the first day?
options: She checked the address and prepared her documents
To be ready before the placement began

tasks.prompt: Choose the correct modal verb: 'You ___ inform your supervisor if you are ill.'
Choose TWO professional habits for the first day of a placement.
Complete: 'A person who guides you at a workplace is your ___.'
You may arrive late because of a transport problem. What should you do?
options: Contact your supervisor as soon as possible.
Ask a friend to sign in for you.

tasks.prompt: Read the placement information; Plan the journey; Meet the workplace supervisor; Follow the first-day instructions
Write 60–80 words about preparing for your first day at a work placement. Include travel planning, documents, punctuality and professional communication.
tasks.rubric: 8 points total: task completion and relevant content (0–2); clear organisation and sequence (0–2); understandable grammar and sentence structure (0–2); appropriate vocabulary, spelling and punctuation (0–2). Minor errors are acceptable if meaning remains clear.
